scope: Two confirmed Thaumonomicon progression/synchronization fixes found while resuming alpha9.14 work. Does not certify whole-mod gameplay parity or additional rendering hardware.

fixes.problem: ResearchProgress charged only the outgoing stage. Completing research skipped warp on an automatic requirement-free final stage; a single required stage also lost the original final-stage addition.

original_source.details: Lines 145-147 read outgoing stage warp; 149-151 select the final stage on completion; 153 adds that stage warp (outgoing again when not completing); 154-164 split positive total into ceil(total/2) permanent and floor(total/2) normal.

implementation.details: applyTransitionWarp is called only after successful requirement validation and once per successful direct or sibling transition. Existing stage/completion guards reject duplicates. Temporary warp is unchanged.

regressions.expected: Final warp 3 adds permanent 2 / normal 1; missing brain and duplicate request leave warp unchanged; temporary warp and one-time item/XP semantics are preserved.
Outgoing 2 plus final 2 adds permanent 2 / normal 2; knowledge is spent once and duplicate request is inert.
Outgoing 5 plus final 0 adds permanent 3 / normal 2, with no accidental doubling.

fixes.limits: Restores the transition calculation against the original default behavior. Does not implement unrelated whole-mod warp events, configuration modes, or administrative-command side effects.

fixes.problem: ResearchActionPayload responses called show(), so open=true could reopen the book after the player closed it while a request was in flight.

original_source.details: Original snapshot includes then clears pending POPUP; client handler updates capability state, queues completion toasts and clears local POPUP without opening a GUI.

implementation.details: Registered handler dispatches to handleResearchAction on the server main thread. Existing book/cooldown/stage guards remain. Successful or rejected validated actions synchronize with sync(), not show().

preserved_behavior: Actual item use in ThaumonomiconItem.use still calls show() and opens the book.
show() records !gotthaumonomicon on the original item use; subsequent action replies preserve this server-owned flag.
ResearchProgress.sync still calls deliverAddenda and includes pending POPUP in the snapshot.
ClientJournal.open updates an existing ResearchScreen/ResearchPageScreen even when payload.open is false; a closed screen remains closed.

regressions.expected: Capture real outbound JournalPayload through a test packet listener: item use sends open=true and records discovery; the actual server action handler sends open=false plus completed research, POPUP, preserved discovery and spent-knowledge state.

fixes.limits: Packet-level server regression validates the no-reopen contract; it is not a new visual client test or an artificial network latency benchmark.

validation.note: Observed completed server build: all 31 GameTests passed. Final client-only blueprint changes and all 1958 JUnit are recorded separately in final-build-summary.json.
